svg.title: Score distribution checks
svg.desc: PL · 76 holdout matches · 2026-03-21 to 2026-05-24 Bars: observed counts. Points: sums of point-fit probabilities; every panel retains its full remainder. No posterior intervals, goodness-of-fit p-values or model selection from these counts.
